Read persisted summaries

Source: R/18-workflow-context.R
bg_read_summaries.Rd

Read persisted summaries

Usage

bg_read_summaries(
  project,
  scope = NULL,
  include_stale = TRUE,
  include_inactive = TRUE,
  predicted_fingerprints = NULL,
  artifact_index = NULL
)

Arguments

project

A bg_handle.

scope

Optional scope filter.

include_stale

Whether to keep stale entries.

include_inactive

Whether to keep summaries from retired or disabled nodes. Defaults to TRUE.

predicted_fingerprints

Optional named fingerprint map.

artifact_index

Optional artifact index.

Value

Named list of summary entries annotated with is_fresh and is_stale.
